lines.text: You're building something your customers love.
And every day, they tell you what they need.
Their questions start in support, move to product, and land with engineering.
But at every handoff, a little of the story gets lost.
What if the story stayed whole, from the first message to the fix?
Support, projects, CRM, meetings and docs, in one open-source workspace, with AI agents that share the whole history.
Echo answers from your docs and past conversations.
When it's a bug, it hands your team everything it found.
Forge prepares the fix. Lens reviews it. You approve.
Quill updates the docs, and your customer hears back in the same conversation.
You decide what each agent can do, and when it asks first.
So your team spends its time on the work, not the handoffs.
Helpin is open source. Self-host it for free, or run it on Helpin Cloud.
Don't lose context between tools and handoffs. Keep everything in one place.
